This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of long-necked [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, solid black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and beak-like [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]]. Several members of this species could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiaxx]]<ref name="MJ5" /> by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Text">Date established in narrative text.</ref> all employed at [[Dequc]]'s [[Casino/Legends|casino]].<ref name="MJ5" />
